findings.issue: Fixture masking leaves the real blog account [redacted] in answer hyperlinks and embedded data-linkdata/data-module JSON. Another answerer remains identifiable through the expert profile storeId=[redacted] at backend/tests/fixtures/http/naver_kin/question-3.html:1287, despite its visible nickname being replaced with user21. Other recommendation profile IDs/names also remain, for example question-1.html:3840. This violates the requested removal of real personal identifiers; masking only visible names and KiN profile u parameters is insufficient.
findings.fix: Replace account-bearing URLs, expert profile/product identifiers, associated names, and their embedded JSON/attribute copies with consistent synthetic values while retaining markup structure. Add a fixture privacy check covering URL attributes and embedded data, not only visible nicknames, emails, or phone patterns.

findings.issue: Repeated pages do not terminate pagination, contrary to 02-design.md:81. A MockTransport returning list-1.html for both page 1 and page 2 produces identical normalized URL sets but next_cursor="3" for page 2. The seen set is local to one page, and CommunityAdapter has no cross-page repeat detection. The worker forwards next_cursor (backend/app/crawl/worker.py:324), and the queue schedules it (backend/app/crawl/queue.py:338), so duplicate results trigger unnecessary later requests and may keep advancing when pagination links advance too.
findings.fix: Track the preceding normalized URL-set signature and cursor per keyword, following the existing Naver search adapter behavior, and set next_cursor=None on a repeated later page. Keep same-cursor retries and different keywords independent. Add a regression test returning the same captured results for two consecutive cursors and asserting termination.

notes: HEAD matched the requested review commit; the initial working tree was clean. The diff contains exactly the 16 approved files, including the three controller-approved channel-set/count changes. git diff --check passed.

Requested crawl suite completed with exit code 0: 541 passed, 1 existing Pydantic deprecation warning in 56.80 seconds. VOYAGE_API_KEY was unset. Bytecode and pytest cache writes were disabled; test temporary files used the normal writable temporary directory.

List implementation uses query/page URL parameters and positive page cursors; captured pages each yield 10 unique dirId+docId-normalized URLs. Tests cover page 2 and termination without later links (backend/tests/crawl/adapters/test_naver_kin.py:47, :104, :114). Cross-page repetition is the missing essential case described above.

No rows without a no-result marker raise ValueError; rows lacking a title link or either question ID also raise ValueError (backend/app/crawl/adapters/naver_kin.py:29). The true empty fixture is list-noresult.html, as required by T0; list-changed.html exercises structural failure.

Detail tests check exact question titles/dates, no comments, answer counts, metadata and decoded tags for all three captures (backend/tests/crawl/adapters/test_naver_kin.py:134). Tags are percent-decoded via unquote (backend/app/crawl/adapters/naver_kin.py:85). The body selector isolates the question and removes image placeholders/scripts/styles; author_raw is None.

Deletion detection reads the entire HTML, including the head script (backend/app/crawl/adapters/naver_kin.py:77). Additional in-memory probes confirmed AdapterSkipped(reason="deleted") for 게시물이 삭제되어, 삭제된 게시물, and 존재하지 않는 게시물. Only the first captured variant has a committed regression test; covering the others would improve robustness.

An in-memory question-1 mutation removing every 작성일 label returned date=None, even with item.date populated (backend/app/crawl/adapters/naver_kin.py:88). This does not borrow an answer date or search date. Unknown dates are supported by the existing filter behavior (backend/app/crawl/filters.py:53); add a test documenting this choice. No mandatory missing-date error is specified.

403 and 429 are converted to AdapterBlocked by CommunityAdapter; tests cover both list and detail with one request only (backend/tests/crawl/adapters/test_naver_kin.py:162). The limiter reads app.crawl.channels defaults and has a monkeypatched-default spacing test (:184).

Privacy scans covered raw and percent-decoded fixture text, starred IDs, emails, mobile phone patterns, account/profile URLs and visible profile names. No starred IDs, email addresses, or mobile phone matches were found. Account/profile URL leaks are documented in the finding. Visible answerer names and KiN u parameters are synthetic; question and answer text lengths measured 22-80 characters while real parsing classes and nested markup remain.

The added adapter tests exercise real captured markup through MockTransport and would fail without the new module/registration. Existing suite success does not cover the privacy leaks or repeated-page termination.
Only docs/development/channel-expansion/reviews/T5.json was created in the repository; no product, test, fixture, index, or Git-ref changes were made.
